profile.headline: Software Engineer at Citi | Application Co-Owner | Angular • TypeScript • JavaScript | Enterprise Applications
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer at Citi with 5+ years of experience building enterprise applications across web development, conversational AI, and internal platforms.
I currently serve as Application Co-Owner for MyView, an internal feedback and survey platform integrated across 50+ Citi applications. My role has grown beyond development into end-to-end application ownership, including product planning, backlog prioritization, requirements, UI/UX design, Angular development, testing, production support, and releases.
Some of the work I'm most proud of has come from identifying opportunities beyond assigned requirements. I conceived, designed, and delivered My Reviews, which gives users visibility into what happens after they submit feedback, as well as an Advanced Analytics experience that helps application teams identify dissatisfied users, unresolved concerns, recurring problem areas, and opportunities for improvement.
Earlier in my Citi career, I worked on customer-facing search experiences using Angular and contributed to a React proof of concept for an internal knowledge-sharing platform. I later worked on Citi's conversational AI experiences, developing chatbot flows with Kore.ai and JavaScript and performing NLP training and testing to improve intent recognition.
I enjoy working at the intersection of software engineering and product ownership—understanding the problem, designing a solution, building it, and ultimately seeing it through to production.

Technologies: Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, HTML/CSS, REST APIs, Git, Jira, Agile, Jenkins, Kore.ai, NLP

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Progressed through multiple engineering teams at Citi, from customer-facing web development and conversational AI to my current role as Application Co-Owner for MyView, an internal feedback and survey platform integrated across 50+ Citi applications.
 
MyView | Application Co-Owner
 • Lead day-to-day product and technical ownership, including backlog prioritization, sprint planning, requirements, UI/UX design, development, testing, production support, and releases.
 • Own features end-to-end from identifying product needs and defining acceptance criteria through Angular development, testing, and production deployment.
 • Conceived, designed, and delivered My Reviews, enabling users to track submitted feedback, review status, reviewer responses, resolutions, and associated engineering tickets.
 • Conceived and delivered Advanced Analytics, transforming survey data into actionable insights around user dissatisfaction, unresolved concerns, problematic categories, and engagement trends.
 • Serve as a primary point of contact for application teams integrating with MyView and troubleshoot integration and production issues.
 
COVA | Conversational AI
 • Developed customer-facing chatbot experiences using Kore.ai, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and REST APIs.
 • Built dialogue flows, intents, and conditional logic, and performed NLP training and batch testing to improve intent recognition and conversational routing.
 
Search Platform
 • Developed customer-facing search functionality using Angular, including keyword-driven Quick Links, and improved ADA/accessibility compliance across landing pages.
 • Contributed to CitiStack, a React POC for an internal Stack Overflow-style knowledge-sharing platform.

positions.title: Laboratory Technician
positions.description:
Schlumberger  	San Antonio, Tx

Laboratory Technician 2 	       09/2015 - 04/2020

  - Developed custom reportinging template to automate workflow for lab tech across North and South America, improving efficiency in monthly administrative tasks by 93%. 
Acting crew lead managing 250 projects annually coordinating work cross functionally to meet client specifications based on RFP.
  - Mentored interns/new employees ensuring new hires learned best practices and minimized employee attrition. 

Schlumberger 	Alice, Tx

Laboratory Technician 1 	       06/2011 - 09/2015

  - Designed cementing systems using LabDb and Cementics proprietary software to help achieve Zonal isolation and promote well integrity. 
Identified appropriate testing needs based on client specifications minimizing loss.
  - Acted as liaison between client and engineering team in execution of sample testing.
